caption: The drawing depicts a rural landscape scene featuring multiple figures and elements. In the foreground on the left, two male figures wearing hats and blue shirts are harvesting or gathering green plants from the fields. In the central area, there is a large, pink-toned building with a tiled roof, surrounded by vivid green fields, shrubs, and cypress-like trees. Toward the right, there are two sheep grazing near a stream or a small river, and behind them, a boy wearing a wide-brimmed hat and blue clothing is sitting on the bank, fishing with a rod. Further in the background, additional buildings are visible with similar pinkish-red tones set amidst more green land and trees. The sky is light blue with pink-tinged clouds, and the composition uses bold green, pink, red, and blue hues for contrast. The illustration is bordered on the top and sides by an unfinished rectangle, with substantial blank space below. In the bottom right corner of the illustration, there is some small text, possibly the artist's signature.
title: Wall Paper Border Design
